description: This file defines a styled React component for a custom button, using Material-UI's styling system. It exports a default styled Button component with various style variants and ownerState-based styling logic.

methods.name: containedStyles
methods.description: Defines styles for the 'contained' variant of the button, including background, color, box-shadow, and focus/hover states.

methods.name: outliedStyles
methods.description: Defines styles for the 'outlined' variant of the button, including border, background, and hover/focus states.

methods.name: gradientStyles
methods.description: Defines styles for the 'gradient' variant, including background gradient, box-shadow, and states.

methods.name: textStyles
methods.description: Defines styles for the 'text' variant, primarily text color and hover/focus states.

methods.name: circularStyles
methods.description: Defines styles for circular buttons, setting border-radius.

methods.name: iconOnlyStyles
methods.description: Defines styles for icon-only buttons, adjusting size, padding, and icon margin.
